author: Saikron
body:
Hello,


As far of the two "appeals" I already made, I can say there was a progress in terms of clarifying things, but not as much as I`d like because the lack of effort  and interestof the Official team and people envolved in this infraction & desqualification of Eternal Cross, which make me and my team upset.

Now, I will explain, as generally and synthesize, me saik can.
Please take all this points on consideration.
There`s no bias on any of this statements, just facts & recopilations of what this two appeals gave us, with debatible things & other already clarified things.

Thank you.


Okay, so let`s start getting some facts envolved (clarified) so they can be useful on the next things.
Appeal 1 and 2:
(this are some facts regarding topic 1`s debate)

-Even if Novalikes is my leader on EC, there`s no way or even no unity with something he said to an administrator and me. If a X player says something, there`s no reason thats 100% it`s true, possibly he wants to perjudicate the other team, what is actually obvious.

-"You said that he was on an alternate teamspeak on your other appeal."
Nova was on alternative teamspeak and on Avicus teamspeak, I said that on both, appeal one and two I gave more details, So I don`t understand why, on appeal 2 reply, you replied that. As I said, Nova was on our teamspeak and Avicus one, as its logical because that was the reason because Scaglia was on our Alternative teamspeak, to hear nova just say strats and nothing else, because his job is to referee, as hes a referee, as you said here "There could have also been many options that can be considered as having an unfair advantage, such as a player livestreaming and nova watching it and providing you guys with strats." Because of that, there`s no possibility about Nova making tactical info, and seriously, tactical info on TDM maps and Qualifiers? no way...
That`s the reason the`re refs.

-Im just saying this to clarify is someone didnt understand. I didn`t lied about my mic. There`s no fisical difference between a broken mic (which I cannot use) and no mic, the only difference SOMEONE can see or hear, is that a broken mic can make a silly noise, and no mic can.. well.. you know.

-Fourth, even if Nova was not ban evading on your account, EC would still have to face the penalties as Nova was on another teamspeak assisting you guys in the tournament. Okay, lemme clarify you this "point". As I said multiple times, Scaglia, a referee of avicus, ( I can see know that you dont really take in consideration referees performances ) was on our EC teamspeak & on avicus teamspeak, so theres NO way we could get any tactical info or any type of useful help by someone external to the matches, so there`s no possibility of penalty.
Oh, and a team disqualified and a player banned is not the same as a penaltie.

-Also, you said that you used the mic on your mom's iphone headphones. But the mic on that doesn't work on computers.
I can`t believe you said this. My friend Jotrexwitz told me how to use Iphones mics for pc months ago, As I use my moms pc when I go to his house, you can see a tutorial of how here;  ( I didnt learned by watching that video is just a reference, not how I learned because jotrex told me to by "talk" ) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aUnobIoFTUc

-Anyways, you've been changing your stories for each argument multiple times.
I completely disagree on what you said, like every thing on last appeal`s reply.
I havent changed "stories" as you call them on any argument, you can JUST and ridiculous say that I "changed" about nova`s on ts, because I didnt add extra information on Appeal 1 saying "Nova was on avicus teamspeak too", which I "forgot" to add, well, im a person like every after all.

Okay, on summary, this takes us to the simple facts.

-I didnt changed any argument on the two appeals, just added more details to complete them as there where not "good" and without "details" for the replier.
-Phones mics can be used on PCs, thats a well-known fact.
-Scaglia was everytime on Avicus & ec teamspeak, so there was no posibility of illegal "Information" of anything, so theres no posibility of a penalty (third time, if you dont believe me ask him by yourselfs, is not that difficult).
-Theres no relationship about nova said or someone said with me, as I stated earlier.

¿So what I`m asking?

-unban my account, I was the one that played on the tournament and nova does not have my account, as I clarified on the facts above and days ago.
-Rejoin eternal cross on Battle of Eternity, because there`s no legitimable reason that we said something away from tournaments rules.
-Read all this message and please take the 3 appeals information in consideration.


I don`t remember is you remember (xd) about what Neyke said on my first appeals reply.
"We have really no interest on appealing this", that was similar to the first or second line of what he read, I think thats ridiculous, biased, salty and rude. Im not here if you want me to, Im here to say what I think, and appeal for a situation that I think its wrong.

I was the one who played on the tourmament, you, fouled, at that time, you had the opportunity to make what you wanted, screenshare me or ask me to download whatever you wanted, but you didnt, you just wanted me to talk, I have some personality problems and thats also why i get nervous or not talk at all on ocn & avicus scrimages, so listen and read, the`re always other options for doing things, and doing things well.


As for finishing, I want (if its possible) the reply of the lord owner of this server, funkystudios, so please if theres a possibility, please take this, funky, on consideration.


Thank you all, I will be really pleased if you read all of what I writted and think and think about what I had stated all this weeks, I really like avicus and i dont want to get my team disqualified and me getting banned of my fav server, please take it in consideration.


This is all, thank you for all your time this days, and.. WOW, I improve my english writting all this! XDDDDDD i dont usualy have good english lessons on my school and i learn more here on avicus and google translator than here.... XD


saik.
